svg.title: phytyl-tail-builder
svg.desc: Name of the tool, the line "Rebuilds truncated chlorophyll tails for Amber tleap, as natural phytyl", and the skeletal formula of phytyl with its 7R and 11R centres and the 2E double bond marked.
